headline: Zoo-Born Red Wolf Pups Find Hope in the Wild
meta_description: Three critically endangered red wolf pups bred at Saint Louis Zoo were successfully fostered into a wild family in North Carolina, offering hope for the specie…
summary_short: Three red wolf pups born in captivity at Saint Louis Zoo have been fostered into a wild family in North Carolina, boosting conservation efforts for fewer than 40 remaini…
body:
Three critically endangered red wolf pups born at the Saint Louis Zoo have been successfully fostered into a wild family in North Carolina. With fewer than 40 red wolves remaining in the wild, each new generation represents a crucial lifeline for the species.

The pups were placed with a wild family through a careful fostering program designed to boost the struggling population. Trail cameras deployed afterward captured evidence of the family together, confirming the integration was successful and offering a rare glimpse into the survival of these remarkable animals in their natural habitat.

The effort reflects the delicate balance between captive breeding programs and wild conservation, demonstrating how zoos and wildlife teams work together to pull species back from the brink of extinction.
